en.herolede: POS Admin, Storefront, Affiliate System, and CommerceHub Marketplace — four products, one commerce ecosystem.
en.showcasesub: A commerce ecosystem for merchant operations, online storefronts, affiliate promotion, and marketplace selling.
en.showpos: Manage sales, products, stock, purchasing, and customers from one operational workspace.
en.showstorefront: Present your catalogue online and take customer orders through your own storefront.
en.showaffiliate: Help affiliates find eligible products, share promotion links, and follow their commission records.
en.showcommercehub: Publish eligible products to the marketplace with category, pricing, and approval checks.
en.ersub: Each product has its role, and its relationships with the others are clear.
en.er1desc: Merchant catalog and stock records support Storefront and eligible CommerceHub workflows.
en.er2desc: Merchant settings, content, navigation, and supported themes shape the Storefront experience after saving and publishing.
en.er3desc: Affiliate promotion connects to supported Storefront shopping journeys.
en.er4desc: Eligible products undergo category, pricing, and approval checks before marketplace publication.
en.er5desc: Storefront orders remain distinct from marketplace orders, which create seller sub-orders.
en.er6desc: Each audience has its own access context, and Affiliate commissions remain separate from marketplace fees.
